pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit a polygonal geometry with soft-edged pixel gradients. Patches on the upper torso and neck are larger and more regular in shape, while those on the posterior and lower limb regions show increased irregularity and reduced spatial area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored interstitial space forming a topological graph. Junctions are predominantly tri-radial. The pixel thickness of these corridors varies, being most prominent on the neck and shoulder regions before narrowing into a finer mesh on the flanks.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The 1D silhouette of the dorsal mane exhibits a high-frequency, low-amplitude serration. It appears as a dark, jagged boundary against the desaturated background along the upper neck curvature.
